lines.text: Many learners say: Eventually, I go to the gym on Sundays.
Better: Sometimes, I go to the gym on Sundays.
The second! I go to the gym sometimes.

data.wrong: Eventually, I go to the gym on Sundays.
data.right: Sometimes, I go to the gym on Sundays.

quiz.stem: I go to the gym ___, not every day.

native.tip: Em português “eventualmente” quer dizer “às vezes”; em inglês, “eventually” quer dizer “no fim”. Para “às vezes”, use “sometimes”.

Para “às vezes”, use “sometimes”. Ouça a Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.

en.tip: In Portuguese “eventualmente” means “às vezes”; in English, “eventually” means “in the end”. For “às vezes”, use “sometimes”.
en.caption: Do you say this too? “Eventually, I go to the gym on Sundays.” 😅 The right way is “Sometimes, I go to the gym on Sundays.” In Portuguese “eventualmente” means “às vezes”; in English, “eventually” means “in the end”. For “às vezes”, use “sometimes”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
